name: Duck Hunters 2

features.name: Scatter wins
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere.

review:
Duck Hunters 2 is a 5x6 scatter-pays sequel where eight or more matching symbols anywhere win and drop away. xWays symbols reveal a paying symbol and double, quadruple or octuple the multiplier on their position. Infectious xWays spread that symbol further.

Bombs go off once no wins remain, clearing the area around them. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 40,000x cap. If you like position-multiplier tumble games, this is Nolimit City's version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
